e2e/features/discount-codes.feature:
@cart
Feature: Discount codes
  A shopper can enter one discount code at checkout. A code that applies lowers
  the total; a code that doesn't says why, and the total stays the same.

  Background:
    Given the shop is open with an empty cart

  Rule: A code that applies lowers the total

    Scenario Outline: <code> gives <saving>
      Given my cart has <quantity> "<product>"
      When I apply the code "<code>"
      Then the total is "<total>"

      Examples:
        | code     | saving                  | quantity | product       | total  |
        | SAVE10   | 10% off                 | 2        | Blue notebook | $20.30 |
        | BULK15   | 15% off 5 or more items | 5        | Blue notebook | $41.12 |
        | FREESHIP | free shipping           | 2        | Blue notebook | $17.00 |

  Rule: A code that doesn't apply says why

    @smoke
    Scenario: An unknown code is turned down
      Given my cart has 2 "Blue notebook"
      When I apply the code "HELLO"
      Then I am told "“HELLO” isn't a valid code."
      And the total is "$22.00"

    Scenario: The bulk code needs enough items
      Given my cart has 2 "Blue notebook"
      When I apply the code "BULK15"
      Then I am told "BULK15 needs at least 5 items."
e2e/features/job-application.feature:
@application
Feature: Applying for a job
  An applicant fills in the application one step at a time. A step can't be
  left until its answers are valid, and going back never loses an answer.

  Background:
    Given I am on the first step of the application

  Scenario: Every missing answer is pointed out
    When I continue without answering
    Then "Full name" is marked as needing an answer
    And I am still on the "Personal details" step

  Scenario Outline: The email has to be usable
    Given I have filled in my personal details with the email "<email>"
    When I continue
    Then the email is turned down with "<problem>"
    And I am still on the "Personal details" step

    Examples:
      | email             | problem                                       |
      | ada               | Enter an email address like name@example.com  |
      | taken@example.com | An application with this email already exists |

  @smoke
  Scenario: Going back keeps my answers
    Given I have filled in my personal details
    When I continue
    And I go back
    Then my personal details are still filled in
